risk_summary: The disclosure is strongly quantified and generally transparent about sales, margins, cash flow, input-cost inflation, and segment drivers. Risk tone is predominantly confident and promotional, while reliance on non-GAAP, constant-currency, and adjusted measures may make underlying performance less immediately comparable. Key risks include consumer health, persistent labor and input-cost inflation, volume weakness, and supply-chain conditions.
